properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.client.authorization.aws.connections.*.region
properties.description: AWS region used in the SigV4 credential scope. Uses the default AWS region provider chain when omitted.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.client.authorization.aws.connections.*.allow-insecure-http
properties.description: Whether SigV4 credentials may be sent over clear-text HTTP. Enable only for trusted local tests.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.client.authorization.aws.connections.*.signing.additional-unsigned-headers
properties.description: Additional exact, case-insensitive header names excluded from SigV4 signing input. Headers remain on the wire without SigV4 integrity protection. Blank names are rejected; case variants are deduplicated.
